translation_notes.altText: Original insertion offsets selected an image. Current production edits the same selected reference by attachment ID; same filenames, whitespace, sanitization, missing-reference and unchanged-document assertions remain.
translation_notes.attachmentDeepLink: Production collaboration resolves fragments and selected spans. URL-write/copy cases mount the actual Files text preview and fail on missing selectable lines. Extension-helper fixtures assert actual viewer dispatch rather than an obsolete private helper return value.
translation_notes.ansi: Cases read spans/text/style from actual FilesController.preview output. No ANSI implementation is supplied by the adapter.
translation_notes.downscale: Dimensions and byte estimates read the actual production offer. A null offer leaves the source dimensions untouched.
translation_notes.files: Deleted helper behavior is exercised through actual FilesController.render/renderLinks/remove and current Rust MIME-filter markup. Boundary DOM stubs do not supply production decisions.
translation_notes.projectArchives: The removed administration download extraction is retired. Native browser cases observe real fetch options/current cookie/no-save while fetching and real response bytes/filename/owner checks. Document-disposal cancellation and same-user session replacement remain incomplete. The retained session observer case executes the shared session script still used by unfinished routes.
translation_notes.uploadQueue: Original task queue assertions now drive actual attachment composer upload admission. Boundary DOM and upload outcomes are controlled; observer promises settle only from production onUploaded/onStatus and terminal item state, never directly from transport outcomes. Admission, completion and slot release are production behavior.
translation_notes.annotateMath: Root owns live production annotation adapters. Fixed production60-entry undo bound replaces obsolete arbitrary-limit helper; additional browser test executes actual annotation UI/canvas.
